meta.apiName: Pockit Mock Product and Coupon API
meta.description: Fictional sample data for Pockit development and UI testing only. Retailers, products, prices, stock levels, discounts, coupon performance and offers are not real.
meta.notice: All prices, stock levels, discounts, coupon performance and offers are simulated. Retailer names are fictional demo entries. Product links open related Jumia Kenya searches and retailer website links open the Jumia Kenya marketplace; these are not official retailer listings. Coupons and vouchers are visible for UI testing but are not redeemable at real retailers.
